other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Cited reference describing waste-heat recovery via vapour absorption refrigeration applied in the sugar industry (a continuous-process sector), mentioned only as background, not this paper's application
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Case study of such system with application in sugar industry is presented in 
[6], where turbine exhaust gases with temperature of 109 C are used by vapour absorption refrigeration system.

one_line: The paper is an energy audit of a medium-size bakery (batch food production), analyzing steam-generation and boiler-house efficiency measures; its application context is discrete/batch food processing, not any continuous-flow Corpus B sector.
